label: Community contribution total
disclaimer: SeaDays currently records community contributions against estimated voyage footprints. The environmental initiative supported by these contributions will be announced once confirmed.

notes: Distance uses Haversine between itinerary ports (or ~480 nm/day when coordinates are incomplete).
Contributions spend SeaDays Points against the estimated footprint (200 or 500 points per tonne, or custom at/above minimum).
Recording writes to carbon_offset_history via the SeaDays edge API.
